# Theory: Desired State Lives in Git; the Cluster Converges

GitOps’s four pillars: Git as source of truth, declarative desired state, pull-based agents, continuous reconciliation. Push-based CI (`kubectl apply` from a pipeline) is CIOps, not GitOps.

## Invariants

1. If it is not in Git, it is drift.
2. The agent, not the human, writes to the cluster API.
3. Preview environments are extra desired states (extra Git refs or folders).

```text
Git desired  --pull-->  reconciler  --apply-->  cluster actual
                 compare + converge
```

## What can break

- Manual `kubectl` on a GitOps cluster (the next reconcile fights you).

## How to read this chapter

Pain, pillars, benefits, push vs pull, env repos, trunk vs PRs, vs other *Ops, when.
